paragraphs.text: Prayer grounds first: past-grounds, one-hoard selves, knowing-frames, pain-thieved farings. Beyond prayer-grounds, strange-fruit-giver: victorious, unprecedented-storied, Shiva the wish-tree.

Then face and melting. When will foot-thought-jewel-creeper-fruition, amazing the perfected, befall me, from You? When, Lord, shall I fully see Your pure face-orb, from which streams unprecedented-nectar-flood, drowning the world whole? Your form, risen at mere meditation — when, Lord, will it ever fill my far gaps with unprecedented-nectar floods? By touch of Your peerless rasa, unroaming abandoned: not now is my mind, Lord. When will it be? Let it be soon. Not dry-bitter things only: nay, all, always — to You offered, gained: even opposites rush me. Lord, may Your pure rays come face to face, as long as body-mind-heat-dark is wiped out. God, be gracious till my path-blockers, truth-stealing, sense-thieves are tamed. With Your devotion-nectar-essence fill my mind fast, Lord: till these are carried off, drowned — all sapless hankerings.

Then freedom and Master. In liberation-state, where is devotion to You — how could it even shine for the mortal-natured? Nay. So me, Unborn, on a fitting attainment-ground raise. Greedy for a siddhi-drop’s gain, with smugness settle me not: starved, before Your devotion-face, is freedom; sprouting wonder-wings. May the Lord be pleased with me, His slave — this much alone I beg. In mind brimmed with Your frame-mindfulness-nectar-sap: Your lotus-feet-pair in mine, blooming be ever — honey-oozing, beyond the world. Mine is the Master, yonder: father, then Three-eyed, then mother BhavAnI. No second here, whoever is mine: thus most-fulfilled may I roam.
